_doc: Session-model-aware worker routing matrix. Maps (session_model, task_type) to worker model.

rules.haiku_only_when: Task has complete code spec (function signatures, types, tests defined). Never for prose/ambiguous tasks.
rules.final_review: Subagent review uses sonnet, never opus. Opus is orchestrator-inline only.
rules.override: Controller can override with justification logged as Ruling.
